author: Karen Manor
text: Were you laying on it with this reading?  Does it improve when you move?  What is a fingerstick reading with this report? Then as others have said generally a reading of 70 is not considered low.

author: Marcie Mckinley
text: Did it come back up by itself or did you treat it?  We get a slow drop like that sometimes as well I roll him over and it comes back up. He might be just half on it and it will do this to us.
